name: Dusty conditions
quote: Service more frequently when operating in severe conditions: dusty, wet, muddy, high speed, or frequent starting/stopping.

name: Wet conditions
quote: *C: Service more frequently when operating in severe conditions: dusty, wet, muddy, high speed, or frequent starting/stopping.

name: Road salt / sea air
quote: After riding in an area where the roads are salted or near the ocean, immediately wash your vehicle with cold water.

name: Cold start
quote: Keep the battery well charged especially during cold weather.
